sources.notes: The official page exposes the sign archives, but the page does not grant an app-redistribution licence. Archive presence is not treated as permission to bundle.

sources.notes: The reviewed categories expose per-file metadata and many files declare Public domain / PD Switzerland (Official documents). Each selected file still needs exact code, revision, checksum and provenance recorded before packaging.

packaging_decision: Source-preparation artwork may be staged in evaluation-only mobile bundles for shadow testing; do not enable production redistribution or rollout until per-file source and redistribution review is complete and the classifier has independent Swiss evaluation evidence.
